sos_button_visible_by_default.description: Show the full-width SOS button on a fresh install.

voice_button_visible_by_default.description: Show the 'Say a Command' voice bar on a fresh install.

voice_commands_feature_enabled.description: Kill switch: false removes voice commands entirely (Home bar + Settings toggle), overriding user preferences.

high_contrast_feature_enabled.description: Kill switch: the high-contrast theme toggle. OFF by default - feature parked pending a design pass; flip to true to restore it without an app update.

apps_row_feature_enabled.description: Kill switch: false removes the Apps Row entirely (Home row + Settings section), overriding user preferences.

apps_row_curated_pool.description: Comma-separated package names filling the Apps Row before launch history exists. May be longer than apps_row shows - uninstalled packages are skipped.

high_contrast_by_default.description: Start new installs in high-contrast mode.

fall_detection_enabled_by_default.description: Turn fall detection on by default. Note: requires the physical-activity permission, so leaving this off avoids an unprompted permission ask.

fall_sensitivity_default.description: Default fall-detection sensitivity. One of LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH (case-insensitive). Anything else falls back to MEDIUM.

sos_hold_duration_ms.description: How long the SOS button must be held to fire, in milliseconds. Clamped to 1000–10000 in-app.

sos_countdown_seconds.description: Seconds the SOS countdown screen ticks (with a Cancel button) before dispatching. Clamped to 3–30 in-app.

favorite_apps_max_count.description: How many apps the Home screen's My Apps row shows. Clamped to 4–24 in-app.

weather_api_base_url.description: Weather API base URL. Free keyless Open-Meteo by default. To migrate to the paid plan without an app update: set to https://customer-api.open-meteo.com and set weather_api_key. Must be https; invalid values fall back in-app to the free endpoint.

weather_api_key.description: Weather API key, appended as &apikey= when non-blank. Blank = keyless free tier. Set together with weather_api_base_url when moving to the paid Open-Meteo plan.
